title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the publish backfill pair and the draft pair out of protocol.ts into protocol-publish-backfill.ts and protocol-drafts.ts (#25467 cut 12)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7JKgiM29GUcitRvoGGj5BU)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

Cut 12 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–11 landed as #25494, #25518, #25538, #25589, #25601, #25623, #25642, #25719, #25731, #25740 and #25797. The claim is `6407710285`; the scope is the cut 12 proposal of the cut 11 report (`6397905786`), as the server seat approved it in its dispatch order.

Four `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` members move unedited into two new modules (#23050 shape B, one `engine` getter each), one per family, because the two families share no helper and no member:

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-publish-backfill.ts`: the publish backfill pair, `planPublishBackfill` and `applyPublishBackfill`.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-drafts.ts`: the draft pair, `listDrafts` (public) and `discardDraftInItsScope`.

`protocol.ts` loses 146 net lines (29,769 to 29,623). The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread. It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record. It holds the move commit `31ecbf1a`, the pin commit `6d1256e1`, both on `main` `cb0a2fcf4f` (cut 11's merge `4893a2fb2c` is in its history), and the merge of `main` `f00e8d5c3c` (`d6e35b43`). That merge brought one commit (#25830) that touches no file of `packages/metadata-protocol/` (the package's `src/` tree is `980b4345` at both `cb0a2fcf4f` and `f00e8d5c3c`).

**Serial with the file's in-flight PRs.** Measured just before this PR was opened: of the 9 open PRs, two touch `packages/metadata-protocol/src/`. #25813 edits `seed-loader.ts` and its test, disjoint. #25826 has one `protocol.ts` hunk, at lines 9021–9060, textually disjoint from this cut's hunks (the imports near the top, seven module-level declarations above line 4000, and the class between lines 23440 and 24900); whichever lands second merges `main`.

## What moves

| Member | Base line | Visibility | Module | AST tokens (params + return + body) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `listDrafts` | `:23440` | public | `protocol-drafts.ts` | 233 |
| `planPublishBackfill` | `:23651` | private | `protocol-publish-backfill.ts` | 620 |
| `applyPublishBackfill` | `:23743` | private | `protocol-publish-backfill.ts` | 852 |
| `discardDraftInItsScope` | `:24875` | private | `protocol-drafts.ts` | 119 |

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1–11 apply it)

- **The class keeps every member** with its name, docblock, signature and position; `listDrafts` keeps its declared public return type. Each body is now one host literal plus a `.call`, marked `[#25467 cut 12]`.
- **Typing.** `PublishBackfillHost` and `DraftsHost` type every member as the class member itself (an indexed access on `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`). Each moved function types its `this` as the `Pick` of its module's host over exactly the members its body reads. Each stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType` of `typeof fn`. No cast, no generic member (so the plain `.call` spelling of cuts 1–10), and no member changes visibility.
- **Members read, measured.** `planPublishBackfill` reads `engine` and `getOverlayRepo`; `applyPublishBackfill` reads `engine` and `updateManyData`; `listDrafts` reads `engine`, `ensureOverlayIndex` and `getOverlayRepo`; `discardDraftInItsScope` reads `deleteMetaItem`. `engine` goes as a GETTER, so the read happens when the body makes it (tests replace it on a constructed protocol); each method goes as a closure on the protocol. No private-static member is read, and nothing on the Release's stay list moves: `runPublishSideEffects`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `publishPackageDrafts` and `discardPackageDrafts` stay in the class. **The order's hypotheses hold.**
- **Every other caller still calls the class method**: `publishPackageDrafts` calls the backfill pair; the `_drafts` doors call `listDrafts`; `discardPackageDrafts` and `revertStoredPackage` call `discardDraftInItsScope`.

## Module-level declarations, by reader

- **Seven gain `export`, none moves.** The bodies read `canonicalMetaType`, `clientFacingFailureText` and the interface `MetadataIssueEntry` (already exported), plus seven declarations that gain `export` in place, as cuts 8 and 11 did: `isItemOfDisabledPackage`, `bundleMemberDiscriminator`, `clientFacingFailureCode`, `publishBackfillRefusal`, `PUBLISH_BACKFILL_PAGE_SIZE`, and the types `PublishBackfillEntry` and `PublishBackfillReceipt`. Six of the seven keep readers in `protocol.ts` (the two types are named by the stubs' own signatures; `publishBackfillRefusal` is thrown by `readPublishBackfillRequest` too). `PUBLISH_BACKFILL_PAGE_SIZE` has no reader left in `protocol.ts`; it stays with its family's declarations (see Acceptance notes). The new modules import them from `protocol.js`; the cycle is evaluation-safe because each is read only inside a function body.
- `index.ts` names what it publishes from `protocol.ts` one by one, so the published surface does not move (measured below).
- **Imports in `protocol.ts`.** One import loses its last reader and is dropped: `discriminateDefaultValueShape` from `@objectstack/spec/data` (2 occurrences at base, the import and `planPublishBackfill`'s call). The new modules import it, `DroppedFieldsEvent`, `UpdateManyDataRequest`, `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR` and `I18nLabel` from the same spec subpaths. The two new statements are the imports of the new modules.

## The published `.d.ts`

The series bar is ruling `6348891160`, sorted-union identity, measured first. Base and head were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree (the closure built at head, then the package's `src/` swapped tree-only to base for the base build and restored from `HEAD` under a trap; `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status` clean and all four touched blobs equal to `HEAD`'s after). Measured twice: before the merge (base `cb0a2fcf4f`, head `6d1256e1`) and after it (merged base, head `d6e35b43`, closure rebuilt with a full `pnpm build`, 119/119).

- **Raw sha256**: `325970c1661efaa6a3762ce7de9e6bb205ea16099784f2b6c5950d62d175b331` at base and at head, on both `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`, 772,838 bytes each, in both measurements (the hash cuts 8–11 reported). **Raw identity holds**, so sorted-union identity holds too. The three private members stay `private NAME;` lines; `listDrafts` prints its declared signature unchanged.
- **Normalised sha256**: `aa05995b9d9a32f69b3416eac92ef86b46d79593001a37bf1bb529ed7a9f8952` at both ends (80 string-literal union runs sorted; this run's own normaliser, so the hash is not comparable with cut 11's).
- **The two builds differ where they should**: `index.js` hashes `bbe1a227b80604e0…` at base (cut 11's head hash) and `066b577863ed02f0…` at head; each of the four functions' `.call(host` sites occurs 0 times in the base bundles and once in the head bundles (ESM and CJS alike).
- **Positive control** on the head tree (on disk, restored from `HEAD` under a trap, hash equal to `HEAD`'s after): `private` dropped from `discardDraftInItsScope` and the package rebuilt. Both `.d.ts` files move to `d0a5c1ec3071d8c8…` and print the member's full signature, its parameter docblock included, so the bar can see a change on these members.
- **Export tables.** The ESM and CJS bundles, loaded at runtime from the package, each export the same 78 names at base and head, in both measurements; the sorted list hashes to `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on all of them. None of the moved functions, the two host types or the seven newly exported declarations appears.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## Proof of move-only

- **Bodies, by AST token** (the TypeScript compiler's AST leaf tokens, JSDoc skipped, over parameters less the added `this`, return type and body): 1,824 tokens compared, **0 differ**. The parameter, return-type and body text, comments included, is also equal with whitespace collapsed, for all four. Negative control: one changed token in `applyPublishBackfill`'s body (`ids.length === 0` to `ids.length !== 0`, on an in-memory copy) makes the check report `differ=1` on that member and 0 on the other three.
- **Class side.** 299 members at base and at head, in the same order. The 295 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading comments included. Each of the 4 stubs sits at its base position and keeps its docblock and signature byte-identical (everything before the body's opening brace).
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`.** 231 of the 239 base statements other than the class are byte-identical, leading comments included. Of the other eight, seven gain the `export` keyword and nothing else, and one is the `@objectstack/spec/data` import, which loses the `discriminateDefaultValueShape` line. Head adds two statements, the new modules' imports.
- **Size.** +401 / −183 over 4 files, 584 changed lines (the order's estimate was 450–550; the 900-line split bar is not reached). `protocol-publish-backfill.ts` has 239 lines, `protocol-drafts.ts` 122.

## Readers of the moved lines

Every test and script that reads `protocol.ts` by path (20 files), and every test file in `packages/` and `scripts/`, was grepped for the four member names and for the seven declarations that gained `export`.

- **No by-path reader of the moved bodies.** Outside `protocol.ts` the names `planPublishBackfill`, `applyPublishBackfill`, `discardDraftInItsScope`, `publishBackfillRefusal`, `PUBLISH_BACKFILL_PAGE_SIZE` and `PublishBackfillEntry` occur nowhere but `CHANGELOG.md` entries; `PublishBackfillReceipt` also names an unrelated local type in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. `listDrafts` is a public verb the tests call through the protocol, not by path.
- `protocol.read-verb-canonical-fold.test.ts` scans `protocol.ts` for request-taking verbs whose required `type` is folded; `listDrafts` takes an optional `type?` filter and is out of that population by the pin's own rule, and its signature line stays in place. Green, list unchanged.
- **Bracketed-refusal pin** (`PRODUCERS`): `applyPublishBackfill`'s three `new Error(` move with its body, so the new module gets a row, `'protocol-publish-backfill.ts': 3`, the module's own count, beside the rows cuts 1, 3, 5, 6, 7 and 10 added. `protocol.ts` goes from 74 to 71 such sites, still above its floor of 5; `protocol-drafts.ts` has none and gets no row. Control: with the first of the module's throws changed to `new TypeError(` (on disk, restored from `HEAD` under a trap, hash equal to `HEAD`'s after), the new row fails with "protocol-publish-backfill.ts no longer constructs errors here — this pin is scanning the wrong file: expected 2 to be greater than or equal to 3" (1 failed, 13 passed); restored, 14/14 pass. (The control's first attempt matched no anchor and changed nothing, so it is not counted; the run above is the second, with its on-disk counts read before the test: 2 `new Error(`, 1 `new TypeError(`.)
- **ADR anchors and decision letters.** `check-adr-anchors` exits 0 at both ends: 85 anchored files, 58,830 citations, **1,847 → 1,846** decision-letter citations, files 8,247 → 8,248. The one letter citation that leaves the anchored surface is `listDrafts`' body comment `[ADR-0131 D6] The environment's pending drafts.`, now in `protocol-drafts.ts` (`protocol.ts` cites ADR-0131 D6 118 times at base, 117 at head). The `protocol.ts` anchor entry does not cover ADR-0131, and no moved body is the mechanism of any entry paragraph, so the new modules get no entry (disclosure only, as cut 8 disclosed its ADR-0090 D11 citation).
- **Durability checker**: `check-durability-degradation-log-level` exits 0 at both ends with identical output. In its `--list` (lines stripped of `[@:][0-9]+`), the one difference is the file of the read seam `guards find() in applyPublishBackfill() → no invented answer`, listed under `protocol.ts` at base and under `protocol-publish-backfill.ts` at head; its verdict is unchanged.
- **Engine-double contract** (`check-engine-double-contract`): exits 0 at both ends. The `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (14022 → 14025, 14047 → 14050). `productionFiles` is 3,701 at base and 3,704 at head: +2 are the new files, +1 is the gitignored `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`, which the spec build writes in the head tree and the clean base tree had not built.
- **Identical output at both ends:** `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet`, `check-filter-alias-parity`. `check-nul-bytes` differs only in the scanned file count, +2. The base-end readings were taken in a clean detached worktree at `cb0a2fcf4f`.
- **Platform checklist.** `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: OK, 1 anchored file in the change set, 29 anchors judged, 0 lost.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-ybjm3h`: 0 of 4 paths hit the register, NOT governed; 584 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge bar.

## Verification

All at head `d6e35b43` unless stated.

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0, before and after the merge. `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol` (the whole touched package) exits 0, no output.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol` suite**, base and head, compared per test name and status (vitest `--maxWorkers=2`, JSON reporter, each run under the shared verify lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0` both legs), on the pre-merge tree (the merge changed no file of the package):
  - Base `cb0a2fcf4f`: 21,509 tests (21,490 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 266 files.
  - Head `6d1256e1`: 21,510 tests (21,491 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 266 files.
  - None lost, none changed status, one added: the new `PRODUCERS` row's case. The base leg is the package `src/` swapped tree-only from `cb0a2fcf4f` (the new modules removed from the tree) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 59 gates on 4 changed paths, the same list before and after the merge; all 59 exit 0 on the merged tree, after a full `pnpm build` (119/119, `VERDICT command-exit 0`) and with the plugin-teardown fixture commit fetched first. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 59 derived, 59 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `PUBLISH_BACKFILL_PAGE_SIZE` now has its only reader in `protocol-publish-backfill.ts` (it had no other reader at base either). It stays in `protocol.ts` beside the other `[#24253]` backfill declarations, whose remaining readers (`readPublishBackfillRequest`, `publishPackageDrafts`) did not move; a later cut that moves the request judgement and the receipt types could take the family whole.
- `listDrafts`' `[ADR-0131 D6]` comment now sits in an unanchored module (see Readers above); the anchor file never named ADR-0131, so nothing that guarded it before stops guarding it.

## Carry-forward

Unchanged from cut 11: public members whose return type is inferred, the bodies kept by a reader (`probeRecord`, `getMetaItemCached`, `findReferencesToMeta`, `packagelessAddress`, `refuseUnmintableMetaType`, `metaTypeNamespaceExists`, `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` with `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad`, the 7 `applyRegistryWriteThrough` callers, `readCodeLayerForCarryForward`), and the private-static readers stay in `protocol.ts`; this cut adds `runPublishSideEffects`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `publishPackageDrafts` and `discardPackageDrafts` to that list, for the reasons the cut 11 report gave.
